class.name: SteamConnectionPath
class.brief_description: A snapshot of an authenticated Steam connection's route and quality.
class.description: Read this snapshot from [method SteamSocketConnection.path] or [method SteamNetworking.peer_path]. Steam reports measurements for the current connection. Sample again for updates.

method.name: get_ping_ms
method.description: Returns the latency measurement in milliseconds.

method.name: get_packet_loss
method.description: Returns Steam's estimated in-order delivery deficit.

members.member: Steam's latency measurement in milliseconds, or [code]-1[/code] before a measurement.

A value from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code] estimated as one minus Steam's local in-order delivery quality. Steam can count reordered packets in this metric. [code]-1.0[/code] means unavailable.

constants.constant: Steam has not identified the route.
Steam reports a direct socket path.
